svg.data-weight-note: 21 lb (9.5 kg) with two 650 W power supplies and two fan modules; a Chapter 2 sentence says 22 lb
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: guide Chapter 1: forty one-GE/ten-GE SFP+ ports, 16 regular and 24 DWDM and ZR capable (purple); four 100G QSFP28 ports (light green)
svg.data-redundancy: two 1+1 power supplies and two 1+1 fan modules, all hot-swappable; the system works with a single fan failure and more than one fan failure shuts it down
